legend.label: Successful
legend.definition: The mission or hardware achieved its recorded goals and ended in a documented, completed way. This describes outcome only; it does not mean the hardware is operating now.

legend.label: Working
legend.definition: NASA sources in the dataset describe the mission or hardware as active on the checked date. Re-check the source for the current state.

legend.label: Lost contact or stopped working
legend.definition: Sources record that contact ended, operations stopped, power was exhausted or hardware was damaged. Loss of contact does not by itself prove the physical hardware has failed.
